SELECT 
		itemname= case item.printable WHEN 1 THEN item.name ELSE 'Counter Sale:'+LTRIM(RTRIM(item.customicode)) END, 
         aliasname=item.customicode,  
		patient=(select name from patient where patient.patientcode=issueheader.patientcode), 
		patientregno=(select regno from patient where patient.patientcode=issueheader.patientcode),
		patientadd1=(select address1 from patient where patient.patientcode=issueheader.patientcode), 
		patientadd2=(select address2 from patient where patient.patientcode=issueheader.patientcode), 
		patientphone=(select phone from patient where patient.patientcode=issueheader.patientcode),
		
		regno=(select regno from patient where patient.patientcode=issueheader.patientcode),

         packingdesc=item.packingdesc,   
         accname = dbo.accounts.name,   
		custalias=accounts.aliasname,
         address = dbo.customer.address1,   
         address2= dbo.customer.address2,    
		custphone=customer.phone,
         salesman = dbo.users.username,   
         issueinvcode = dbo.issueheader.issueinvcode,   
         headerno = dbo.issueheader.headerno,   
         date = dbo.issueheader.date,   




         gcode = issuedetail.gcode,   
         icode = issuedetail.icode,   
         batch = issuedetail.batch,   
         expiry = issuedetail.expiry,   
         looseqty = issuedetail.qty,   
        
        
         packunits= issuedetail.packunits,   
         saleprice= issuedetail.saleprice,   


        
         Id = dbo.issuedetail.IDENTITYCOL,   
         posted=issueheader.posted,   



      
         custTaxRegno=customer.salestaxregno  ,
			dbo.issueheader.referenceno,	
			dbo.issueheader.remarks,



			serverdate=getdate(),
			custcode=dbo.issueheader.acccode,
			salesperson=(select name from salesman where salesmancode=issueheader.smancode)
			

    FROM issueheader,   
         issuedetail,   
         accounts,   
         customer,   
         users,   
         item  

   WHERE ( dbo.issueheader.issueinvcode = :ar_issueinvcode ) AND  
         ( dbo.issueheader.issueinvcode = dbo.issuedetail.issueinvcode) AND  
         ( dbo.issueheader.acccode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
         ( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
         ( dbo.issueheader.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND  
         ( dbo.issuedetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)    

ORDER BY /*dbo.item.customicode,*/
			dbo.issuedetail.issueinvcode,
			dbo.issuedetail.IDENTITYCOL
